title: C482/782/2008 of GOPAL KAPOOR AND ANOTHER Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
C482-782-08
Hon'ble U. C. Dhyani, J.
None is present to press the recall
application no.643/2009. No rejoinder
affidavit is filed on her behalf.
